body:
I noticed my coworker, Alex, had been absent for over an hour. He usually rushes out early in the morning but today was unusually late. My heart raced as I wondered if there were any issues he couldn't share.

Thinking that perhaps it might be something urgent at home, I decided not to confront him right away. Instead, I took a deep breath and checked my own schedule. It turned out I could easily swap shifts without missing our meeting later.

Next: confront the person responsible directly.
